name: SAINTOS V5 - 01 CEO AI AGENT ORCHESTRATOR

parameters.content:
# SaintOS Mega Agent V5

The CEO AI Agent is the center of the workflow.

Manual tests run through the real n8n AI Agent, AWS Bedrock model, memory and workflow tools.

## Inputs

Gmail, WhatsApp, Telegram, voice and portal intake.

## AI Routing

Normalized messages become a CEO instruction packet.

## CEO AI Agent

Real n8n AI Agent with Bedrock, memory and workflow tools.

## Manager Tools

The CEO calls specialist manager workflows as tools.

## Safety

Memory, approval, audit and monitoring.

## Outputs

Drafts only. No live send.

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(item => ({json: {...item.json, normalized: true, receivedAt: new Date().toISOString()}}));
return items.map(item => ({json: {...item.json, channel: item.json.channel || 'manual_demo'}}));
return items.map(item => ({json: {...item.json, contact_id: item.json.email || item.json.phone || item.json.chatId || 'demo-contact'}}));

options.systemMessage: You are the CEO AI Agent. You must coordinate specialist n8n workflow tools before returning a final decision. Draft only. Never send live messages without approval.
